vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in fixed pairs. Certain coloured gnomes will lead you to a bright forest and the others to a more duller one. Sometimes the bright forest will produce more mushrooms and other times the duller one, so it is good to not always chose the gnome that will lead you to the bright forest.
